## Gap ID
SEC-009

## Source
gap-analysis-security

## Description
The NomadExecutor HTTP client sends the ACL token over plain HTTP with no TLS verification option. The token is vulnerable to interception.

## Evidence
- `osimflow/executors/nomad_executor.py` — no TLS verification
- `NOMAD_TOKEN` env var transmitted in clear
- No `verify_tls` parameter

## Severity
Major

## Recommended Mitigation
Add a `verify_tls` parameter to NomadExecutor. Default to True for production. Add `--nomad-tls-verify` CLI flag.

## Labels
gap-analysis, security, nomad, tls, major
